name: 01-catalogue
caption: Catalogue: desktop table, mobile list, compact totals and collapsed navigation.

name: 02-filters
caption: Open filters: select Draft, with sorting and counting-unit controls available.

name: 03-filter-applied
caption: Apply filters: the selected status stays visible in removable chips and the result set updates.

name: 04-product-new
caption: Create product: required fields and a primary preparation action, optional references closed.

name: 05-product-validation
caption: Attempt Next with empty required details: validation stays in context.

name: 06-product-entered
caption: Enter the local QA product details before moving to packing.

name: 07-packing-new
caption: Saved product leads to a separate packing batch; quantities and unit counts remain explicit.

name: 08-packing-split
caption: Split 24 PCS into two units; the preview and remaining quantity expose incomplete dimensions.

name: 09-packing-dimensions
caption: Copy entered dimensions to unit 2: copied measurements still need a separate physical check.

name: 10-packing-draft-saved
caption: Save a complete preparation draft: quantities and checked measurements survive saving.

name: 11-packing-review
caption: Review the batch total and both units’ dimensions in the confirmation dialog.

name: 12-units-created
caption: Confirm creation: the two QA units exist, with measured sizes and links to storage.

name: 13-building-new
caption: New building: concise floor setup and required dimensions, with technical help on demand.

name: 14-building-entered
caption: Enter a dedicated QA building with a 10 × 10 m floor and explicit 5 m height.

name: 15-building-created
caption: Create the QA building as a draft; activation requires a reviewable layout.

name: 16-zone-editor
caption: Add a second location: the accessible preview supports keyboard positioning.

name: 17-zone-entered
caption: Enter QA storage B at X 6 m / Y 1 m; its 3 × 3 m outline fits beside the existing location.

name: 18-zone-created
caption: Save the second location: the authoritative floor map updates to two storage locations.

name: 19-building-active
caption: Activate the complete QA layout; the saved status is Active.

name: 20-map-selected
caption: Select and open location details: the desktop inspector and mobile sheet show the same saved location.

name: 21-storage-recommendations
caption: Find storage for QA unit 1: destination eligibility and next actions are explicit.

name: 22-destination-selected
caption: Choose the QA location: preview shows the target code, exact coordinates and suitability warnings.

name: 23-destination-reserved
caption: Reserve the position: the unit is Reserved, and storage confirmation remains blocked until verification.

name: 24-wrong-destination
caption: Submit a wrong destination code: the inline error keeps storage confirmation blocked.

name: 25-destination-verified
caption: Verified support and upper-unit identity still require a separate physical placement check.

name: 26-stored
caption: Confirm simulated physical storage for the QA unit: the saved state is Stored.

name: 27-move-select
caption: Move starts with the stored source and a separate target selection.

name: 28-move-target
caption: Choose QA storage B; the exact target and occupied source remain visible.

name: 29-move-reserved
caption: Prepare the move; both positions remain held until pickup and placement are confirmed.

name: 30-move-source-verified
caption: The source code identifies the pallet; physical pickup remains a separate confirmation.

name: 31-move-in-transit
caption: After pickup the unit is Moving; destination confirmation will release the source.

name: 32-move-destination-verified
caption: Verify the destination label before confirming physical placement.

name: 33-move-complete
caption: Confirm the move: the unit is Stored in QA storage B and its source is released.

name: 34-measurement-guidance
caption: A unit created from packing directs measurement changes to its preparation batch.

name: 35-stack-start
caption: Stacking begins from the stored supporting pallet; load checks are explicitly not enabled.

name: 36-stack-selected
caption: Select the upper QA unit and review fit, clearance and missing support approval.

name: 37-stack-limit-edited
caption: Editing the support limit keeps reservation blocked until the limit is saved.

name: 38-stack-support-saved
caption: Save the two-level support limit before reserving the upper unit.

name: 39-stack-reserved
caption: Reserve the upper unit at Z 1 m; supporting and upper pallet identities must be checked.

name: 40-stack-physical-checked
caption: Confirm physical placement after both pallet identities match.

name: 41-stack-stored
caption: The upper unit is Stored and remains linked to its supporting pallet.

name: 42-scan-start
caption: Job scanning begins with an explicit location choice.

name: 43-scan-location
caption: The selected location wraps on mobile and keeps Change available; recording is separate from inventory storage.

name: 44-scan-invalid-quantity
caption: Malformed quantity 1,2 stays editable and blocks saving with an explanation.

name: 45-scan-manual-entered
caption: Correct the manual ticket quantity to 12 before saving.

name: 46-scan-duplicate-blocked
caption: Repeated job number and barcode require review of separate physical units.

name: 47-scan-duplicate-reviewed
caption: Explicit duplicate review enables saving the two QA tickets.

name: 48-scan-saved
caption: Saving confirms two ticket records without claiming their pallets are Stored.

name: 49-records-search
caption: Filter records with locations and search the two saved QA tickets.

name: 50-records-selected
caption: Select two QA records; assignment remains separate from inventory storage.

name: 51-records-assignment-choice
caption: Choose QA storage A for the selected records before assignment.

name: 52-records-assigned
caption: Both ticket records show QA storage A; the stored pallets remain in QA storage B.

name: 60-setup
caption: Configured dependencies produce a matching Setup configured heading.

name: 61-about
caption: Public About content remains readable outside the planner shell.

name: 62-privacy
caption: Public privacy content retains its information in the compact layout.

name: 63-terms
caption: Public terms retain their information outside the planner shell.

name: 64-navigation-expanded
caption: Expand the desktop sidebar and open the mobile navigation drawer.

name: 65-navigation-followed
caption: Choosing Scanned records closes the mobile drawer and opens the destination.

name: 66-sign-in
caption: Signed-out access opens the real Clerk form with the requested return route and query.

name: 67-sign-in-validation
caption: An invalid email remains on the real sign-in form for correction.

name: 68-sign-in-return
caption: Real Clerk ticket sign-in returns to the planner route and preserves tab=pallets.

name: 69-draft-discard-prompt
caption: Canceling an edited product asks whether to continue editing or discard the draft.

name: 70-draft-continued
caption: Continue editing preserves the entered QA product values.

name: 72-record-actions
caption: Open a QA record’s actions menu; Change location remains separate from deletion.

name: 73-record-delete-prompt
caption: Deleting one QA record requires confirmation; Cancel preserves it.

name: 74-record-delete-cancelled
caption: Cancel deletion: both QA tickets remain visible.

name: 75-record-bulk-delete-prompt
caption: Bulk deletion shows the selected count and still requires confirmation.

name: 76-record-delete-complete
caption: Confirm deletion of only the two walkthrough QA tickets; the filtered result is empty.

name: 77-map-3d
caption: Switch to 3D while retaining the stored units and their saved locations.

name: 78-map-zoom
caption: Zoom the map while keeping floor context and camera controls available.

name: 79-map-fit
caption: Fit resets the camera to the floor proportions.

name: 80-map-table
caption: Table details preserve the selected location and use a complete heading hierarchy.

name: 81-thai-catalogue
caption: Thai catalogue labels and identifiers fit desktop and mobile layouts.

name: 82-dark-catalogue
caption: Existing dark mode remains readable in desktop and mobile layouts.

name: 83-floor-destination-selected
caption: Follow-up QA pallet P-000005: choose an ordinary floor position in QA storage A.

name: 84-floor-reserved
caption: Reserve P-000005 separately; it remains Reserved and awaits storage confirmation.

name: 85-floor-destination-verified
caption: Verify the correct destination for P-000005. Destination verified and Confirm stored are visible; verification does not confirm placement.

name: 86-floor-stored
caption: Confirm simulated physical placement separately: P-000005 is Stored successfully.
